description: Launch Library 2 is a public API and database of rocket launches and space events: all orbital launches and many suborbital ones, events such as landings, engine tests and spacewalks, agencies and launch service providers, astronauts, space stations, dockings, launch vehicles and launch pads. It is produced by The Space Devs, a volunteer group, as the successor of the Launch Library and Space Launch Now APIs, so that the whole database is accessible to everyone. Coverage is global and spans historical and upcoming launches, updated continuously. Format and access: JSON REST endpoints with filters, plus ICS calendar feeds. Licence: no licence was stated on the overview read; cost is free up to 15 unauthenticated requests per hour, with higher rates for supporters, so we record it as freemium. Caveats: community-maintained data with no formal quality statement, rate limits constrain bulk use, and API versions change. It serves launch demand, pad utilisation and space access resilience analysis. Related catalogue records are GCAT, which also lists launches, and the Seradata SpaceTrak commercial launch and satellite database.
